selection_rule: Choose the highest-token checkpoint passing all thresholds; tie-break by lower Novel macro loss, then lower replay macro loss, then earlier checkpoint.
selection_surface: Novel validation + replay retention only; no Eval60 Gold or FINAL_AUDIT

terminal_classifications.EQUIVALENCE_OR_REPLACEMENT_FAILED: novel gain, replay, or protected capability requirements fail
terminal_classifications.EQUIVALENCE_OR_REPLACEMENT_PARTIAL: broad gain but one noncritical threshold fails
